text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I can't believe how good<n>that felt! It really
seems like mile<n>races are the best distance for me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Should I set the 1,600-meter NHK Mile
Championship as my next goal? Is it<n>really okay to
give up the 2,400-meter<n>Japanese Oaks? Isn't the
grandest<n>European G1 race 2,400 meters long?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...No, I shouldn't try and run 2,400<n>meters. My
biggest goal is to win a<n>European G1. I want to
show the<n>world courage, not recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In order to maximize my possibilities,<n>I'm going to
take on the world one<n>mile at a time! The best
match for me<n>is the NHK Mile Championship, and
that's what I'll be running next!
